messages:
ana.v: Heads-up - QA found multiple invoices from the 2026-10-04 morning run missing GPU compute lines. Example inv_05277p (aurora-ai). Total looks understated on sent PDF.
michael.r: Which emitter ran? standard batch or the low-latency flow?
ana.v: Batch id `batch-2026-10-04-08z`. Logs show emit finishing before the usage-merge step. Snippet from logs:
```
[08:07:10] emitInvoice(inv_05277p) status=EMITTED total=2,140.00 line_items=3
[08:07:12] usage-merge(inv_05277p) status=COMPLETE added_rows=5
```
This ordering implies late-arriving usage was not attached at emit time.
billing-bot: Automated check: batch-2026-10-04-08z -> 16 invoices flagged missing sku compute.gpu; 4 invoices flagged duplicate_pdf_upload. Report: s3://billing/alerts/3123456789/alerts.json
diane: I also see one large delta: inv_05311k would increase by +$15,200 after backfill. That exceeds our $10k manual-approval threshold.
support: Any customers already emailed? We need to avoid confusing them with re-sends. Recommend we pause outbound emails for this batch.
michael.r: Agreed. Plan proposal: 1) Pause outbound email for `batch-2026-10-04-08z`. 2) Run dry reconcile: `billingctl reconcile --batch batch-2026-10-04-08z --dry-run --out s3://billing/recons/dry-3123456789.csv`. 3) Auto-apply backfill+re-emit for deltas <= $10k with `--no-email` first; route > $10k to finance-approvals.
billing-bot: Dry-run kicked off. Partial results: 16 affected; deltas range from -$60 to +$15,200. Two invoices > $10k (inv_05311k +$15,200, inv_05345z +$12,400). Dry-run output (partial): s3://billing/recons/dry-3123456789-partial.csv
diane: For duplicate PDFs, looks like pdf-worker retried after intermittent 504s and re-uploaded. We'll add S3 put idempotency key and make the worker check invoice.state before upload. I'll file a small patch.
support: I'll prepare customer-facing templates for both the general reissue and the high-delta outreach. Put drafts in /docs/support/reissue-2026-10-04.md.
finance-approvals: We'll need signed approval for inv_05311k and inv_05345z before re-sending. I'll package usage events and meter logs.
finance-approvals: Please attach the usage proof and a CSV with invoice_id, old_total, new_total, delta. We'll review within business day.
michael.r: I'll mark all affected invoices DRAFT, run the backfill for those <= $10k, then `emit --batch ... --no-email` for manual QA. Hold the two > $10k until approvals come back.
diane: Patch for pdf-worker idempotency on the way; canary deploy later today. Also adding an emit guard: wait up to 90s for merge confirmation before emitting; will ship as a small change to batch-runner.
support: Noted. Will not send any customer emails until QA sign-off.
billing-bot: Dry-run complete at 3123456920. Full CSV: s3://billing/recons/dry-3123456789.csv. Summary: 14 invoices auto-eligible, 2 require finance-approvals.
michael.r: Starting backfill+re-emit for 14 invoices now (no-email). Will post backfill logs and re-emit diag when done.
finance-approvals: Received packet for inv_05311k and inv_05345z: s3://billing/approvals/3123456789/. Please advise.
finance-approvals: Acknowledged. We'll review and respond with sign-off or questions by EOD.
ana.v: Thanks team. I'll follow up with final logs and the re-emit confirmation once QA passes.
